function wrap(x:number):[number];
function wrap<T>(x:T):[T];
function wrap(x:any):[any]{return [x];}
class Overload{x;constructor(){[this.x]=wrap(1)}}
class ArrayLength{x;constructor(){[this.x]=new Array(1)}}
class EmptyArray{x;constructor(){[this.x]=new Array()}}
class ArrayCall{x;constructor(){[this.x]=Array(2)}}
class TypedArrow{x;constructor(){[this.x]=(():[number]=>[3])()}}
class TypedFunction{x;constructor(){[this.x]=(function():[number]{return [4]})()}}
class IndependentArrow{x;constructor(input:[number]){[this.x]=(()=>input)()}}
class IndependentFunction{x;constructor(input:[number]){[this.x]=(function(){return input})()}}
console.log(new Overload().x,new ArrayLength().x,new EmptyArray().x,new ArrayCall().x,new TypedArrow().x,new TypedFunction().x,new IndependentArrow([5]).x,new IndependentFunction([6]).x);
class AssertedReturn{x;constructor(){[this.x]=(()=>[7] as [number])()}}
class BranchTyped{x;constructor(input:[number],flag:boolean){[this.x]=(()=>{if(flag)return input;return input;})()}}
console.log(new AssertedReturn().x,new BranchTyped([8],true).x);
